title: Axisymmetric coaxial capacitor: (r, z) slice (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
Electrostatics with geometry 'axisymmetric' (x = r, the axis is x_lo, y = z): an (r, z) slice of height H of an infinite coax. The core (rectangle r < a) is a terminal at V0, the shield is a voltage 0 V on x_hi (r = b), the z faces are insulated, so the field is radial. Fill eps_fill. The same coax as coax_capacitor_electrostatics, without its staircased circles.
Analytic: V = V0 ln(b/r)/ln(b/a), E_r = V0/(r ln(b/a)), whole-ring capacitance of the slice C = 2 pi eps0 eps_fill H/ln(b/a) (in F: held charges are whole rings on (r, z)), C' = C/H per m of depth.
Derived values tab: C_ring (core charge / voltage, F), C_per_m (C_ring / H, F/m), Q_shield (scalar output charge_shield = -C V0), W_field (ring-weighted integral of E.D/2 = C V0^2/2), V_mid (probe at the centre of the cell containing r = sqrt(a b)). Expect C 1e-4 (b = 4 mm) to 2.3e-4 (b = 1 mm) below the analytic value (the series ring conductances are a trapezoid rule of ln(b/a): (dx^2/12)(1/a^2 - 1/b^2)/ln(b/a)), W within ~5e-4 (cell-centre E), V_mid ~1e-4.
Sweep tab: C_ring versus the shield radius b (1 to 4 mm) with the dashed C_vs_b, C ~ 1/ln(b/a).
Line profile tab (b = 4 mm): V_radial (field V, V0 in the held core) and E_radial (field E_x = E_r, 0 in the core) from the axis to the shield.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: b_shield
parameters.description: shield (outer conductor) inner radius = domain size along r (swept)

parameters.name: eps_fill
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the fill (PTFE ~2.1)

parameters.name: H_slice
parameters.description: axial height of the modelled slice (insulated z faces)

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius: centre of the cell containing sqrt(a b), where V is about V0/2

parameters.name: C_ref
parameters.description: analytic whole-ring capacitance of the slice in F
